concept: 金融情報を知性に変え、資産の現在と未来を可視化する。(Transforming financial data into intelligence, visualizing the present and future of wealth.)
design_theme: Premium FinTech × Near Future (Luxury financial service meets near-future AI technology)

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui primitives + Lucide Icons

layout_architecture.pc_structure: Left fixed sidebar (Midnight Navy #071A2B, 260px) + Top fixed header (Glassmorphism / Ice White) + Main content scroll area (Ice White #F7F9FC)
layout_architecture.mobile_structure: Top header with mobile drawer trigger for sidebar nav

image_urls.description: Professional business discussion between advisor and client
Executive consulting and strategic financial paper review
Gold bars symbol for high-net-worth asset management

testing_and_accessibility.rule: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and key numerical KPIs MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Javascript React component structure (.js/.jsx) is maintained throughout frontend code.
Implement language switching state (JA / PT / EN) globally using context or state hook.
Apply strict palette: Primary #071A2B, Emerald #00A878, Accent Gold #C9A227 sparingly, Ice White #F7F9FC background.
Include AI Insight badge labels (Fact, Calc, Est, AI) clearly on all AI suggestions and risk items.
Include responsive client drawer, CRUD modals, interactive Recharts charts, and PDF report export function.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent header without backdrop blur or background color.
Always specify data-testid attributes on all interactive components.
Avoid generic centered text layouts or default Vercel designs; enforce high-density FinTech layout.
Ensure contrast ratio complies with WCAG standards for dark header/sidebar text and light main panels.
